title: Different valid caches after a TTL reduction
method: Synthetic observation at 09:05: resolver A fetched a 3,600-second TTL at 08:59, leaving 3,600 - 360 = 3,240 seconds. Resolver B fetched a 300-second TTL at 09:01, leaving 300 - 240 = 60 seconds. This excludes serve-stale and application connection reuse.
alt: Different valid caches after a TTL reduction. Resolver A at 09:05: 3240 seconds remaining; Resolver B at 09:05: 60 seconds remaining. Illustrative values.
